mandatory_integrity_and_shape_conditions: Reuse exactly the previous selected processing file list; no extra scientific-file omission, path collision, truncation or body rewrite. New packaging manifest is separate metadata. Only owned regular files, safe relative paths and same-device hard links; reject symlinked source or destination components and existing staging destinations, with no silent copy fallback.

Include hidden files explicitly, use a fixed known upload root preserving the intended namespace, and preflight selected paths against official uploader restrictions including colon, star, question mark, angle brackets, pipe, quotes/newlines. Do not silently sanitize or omit an incompatible path.

Manifest records original relative path, bytes, SHA256, mode and mtime_ns using exact integers, plus original source/case/processing/freeze provenance and file count. Artifact ZIP hashes are new actual container identities, not old tar equivalence. Upload-artifact loses permissions; reconstruction must verify hashes and apply recorded metadata to newly restored files.

Hard links share the source inode: never chmod/utime/chown staging links to normalize originals. Ensure model writers are finished for a complete snapshot; verify all complete frozen hashes and exact staging/source census, bytes/hash/mode/mtime before and after upload. A changed source or unverified upload cannot be called a complete lossless publication.

Use the same declared uploader/compression/hidden-file configuration for all four arms, no overwrite/delete of earlier immutable artifacts, and actual run/job/attempt-qualified identity plus API ID/size/digest receipt. Include metadata/directory/stream-buffer and remaining portable-tar reserves in actual disk guards; do not reserve another uncompressed whole processing tar that is no longer produced.

Unfrozen snapshots are explicitly PARTIAL, never a successful complete model. A partial publication must be hash-consistent to claim reconstruction; if files mutate or completeness cannot be verified, retain it as unverified partial and disclose that fact rather than manufacture a stable snapshot or scientific completion.
